text:
maria_pm: Heads-up: we need a safe rollout plan for the EU model swap next Tue. Goal: phased tenant slices + a small A/B cohort to validate quality before wider ramp. Thoughts?

jong_eng: propose two abstractions: `slice_flag` (tenant-level percent) and `ab_cohort` (sticky assignment for quality eval). Recipe: 5% slice -> 20% -> 60%. AB cohort: 1% of traffic pinned to quality evaluation for 72h.

rita_sre: telemetry gates required at each hold: p50/p95/p99 latency, overall error rate, client error surface (rate of bot-detected hallucinations), and tail memory OOMs. Abort if p95 > baseline + 15% OR 5xx > 0.4% for two consecutive windows. Hold window = 20m by default.

zoe_cs: CS asks: add `enterprise_hold` and `explicit_optin` mechanics. Enterprise customers should be excluded by default unless they opt-in; provide a 48h notice + rollback SLA. Also need a way to ``freeze_progress`` per-customer from the CS console.

jong_eng: implementation note: flag schema we can store in feature-store: `{"slice":5,"hold_m":20,"ab_cohort_pct":1,"sticky":true,"freezeable":true}`. We will read `freezeable` and set UI hooks.

maria_pm: QA checks before 5% step: run canary smoke path + perf harness for top 50 tenants, run synthetic request patterns (long contexts + small prompts). Who owns smoke endpoint?

rita_sre: I'll own smoke endpoint and the perf harness. Want notifications to #eng-oncall at each step and an automatic rollback if the hard abort rule hits. Also request shadow traffic for 24h before the 5% step for AB cohort.

zoe_cs: add customer-level opt-out doc + CLI snippet for ops. I'll draft and ping legal for notice wording.

jong_eng: note about cache warming: prefix cache primes will make first 10-15m look better/worse depending on shard. Recommend randomized skew for initial 5% so we don't hammer a few shards. Also precomputation of shard assignment before 60% jump.

maria_pm: Rollout timeline ask: shadow 24h -> 5% (20m hold) -> 20% (2x20m holds) -> 60% (1h hold) -> full. AB cohort runs in parallel and reports quality deltas.

rita_sre: Add these to the telemetry contract doc: delta thresholds, sampling windows, dashboards, alert intents. I'll post link when done.

deploy-bot: Rollout job queued: job_id=rc-2026-10-05-09, initial shadow start=2026-10-05T09:00Z, 5% start=2026-10-06T09:00Z. CI green.

maria_pm: Action items: jong to land flag schema + UI hooks by EOD, rita to publish telemetry contract and onboard smoke endpoint, zoe to draft enterprise opt-in/out and freeze flow. Re-check tomorrow 11:00 UTC for signoff. :white_check_mark:
